newsitem.title: USA: Russia not ready for full G7 entry-Japan spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Russia not ready for full G7 entry-Japan spokesman.

text.p: Russia is not ready for full membership in the Group of Seven industrialized nations and its full integration into the international economic system is likely take "some time," according to a Japanese official spokesman.
"Probably it will take some time for the full integration of Russia into the international economic system," said Hiroshi Hashimoto, spokesman for the Japanese delegation at the G7 summit here.
The Denver summit marks the first time Russia will participate in nearly all G7 meetings, though it has been excluded from talks on international macroeconomic issues.
Hashimoto said Russia was not yet ready for those talks.
"There are still certain subjects, which are notably international financial issues or macroeconomic policy issues, which the federation of Russia is not ready to be in," he said.
Yet Hashimoto welcomed Russian President Boris Yelstin's participation at the summit and brushed aside questions on whether or when Russia would be admitted as a full member of the group.
"I personally am not sure how important that terminology is," he added.
